home.title: Welcome to DevDigest
home.subtitle: Local-first AI PR review
home.emptyBody: Add a repository to start reviewing pull requests. Set your API keys once in Settings → API Keys.

add.title: Add a repository
add.intro: Paste a GitHub repository URL — DevDigest clones it locally and imports open PRs. API keys aren’t needed here; set them once in <link>Settings → API Keys</link>.
add.footer: API keys live in Settings · <kbd>esc</kbd> to close
